Question: My son name is Muhammad Huzaifa, is this a good name. My name is Mohd Irshad, my wife name is Mehrun Nisa and my son D.O.B is 12th May 2007. If not a good name then Please. Advise a suitable name. Answer ID: 6934 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 733/733=M/1429) Muhammad Huzaifa is a good name, do not change it. Huzaifah was a senior Sahabi, he was told many secrets by the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ); therefore he was called: ?Sahibu sirri Rasul Allah?. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
